pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-pigmented regions with softened edge gradients. Geometry varies from small sub-quadrilaterals on the upper neck to larger, irregular polygons on the mid-flank and shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways separating the dark patches. The topology is characterized by consistent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes with a pixel thickness roughly 10% of the adjacent patch diameter.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background, transitioning into a smoother contour at the shoulder.
